---
name: context-grounding
description: Re-anchor an unfamiliar, broad, stale, or conflicting repository task before work expands.
---
# Context grounding

Use for unfamiliar repositories, cross-module changes, stale sessions, or conflicting artifacts. Read applicable instructions, relevant artifacts, target code, callers/tests, and current diff. Record goal, scope, constraints, current facts, and material uncertainty; reconcile conflict before implementation.

Do not use for a known one-line edit with clear local context. Exit with an evidence-backed change surface. Reject: “the last session said so” without rechecking current state.
